overview_description.description: Sliceledger is a blockchain network with the aim of empowering an already existing decentralized finance system. Being a multifaceted blockchain development company, Sliceledger has its own blockchain protocol "Slice Protocol", a wallet "Slice Wallet", an extension to Slice Wallet, Slice Token, and a DEX Platform. SliceledgerChain was created for the trendiest apps, games, and digital goods. The Sliceledger Chain is searched, analyzed, and visualized using the Sliceledger Explorer. Most popular marketplaces Bharat NFT and Bouquet NFT are built using this platform.
